title: Platform Pack: Mobile
summary: iOS/Android 対象時の追加正規化項目: mobile_contexts (foreground, background_resume, cold_start, offline, online_recovery, push_notification_entry, deep_link_entry), 権限差, 配布状態, OS/端末差。Coverage Checklist: 7 lens (lifecycle, interruption, connectivity, entrypoint, permission, compatibility, install_state)。典型リスク: 復帰後二重送信、offline 中操作喪失、push/deep link 経由の権限差分、OS 権限拒否後の再試行導線、upgrade install 後の古いキャッシュ。
